links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot outputs on prenatal cfDNA screening
links.effect: Readability scores varied from 9th to 14th grade level, above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: Common themes included inconsistent explanations of the purpose and scope of cfDNA screening, frequent omission of test limitations and downstream implications, and variable readability scores (at a 9th-14th grade level) and terminology that sometimes conflate screening with diagnostic testing.

links.outcome: Presence and quality of source citations in chatbot outputs
links.effect: Citations to high-quality sources were limited or absent.
links.quote: Citations to high-quality sources were limited or absent.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, completeness, and framing of prenatal cfDNA screening information generated by publicly available LLM chatbots across simulated patient age profiles.
